# `{upxdvir}` Demo

## Libraries

```{r}
library("grid")
library("upxdvir")
# options(warn = 2)
# knitr::opts_chunk$set(error = TRUE)
```

## Draw UpTeX Content

```{r, fig.height = 4, fig.width = 1, fig.align = "center"}
grid.rect(gp = gpar(lwd = 10, col = 2))
grid.uplatex("ページレイアウトの設定とし", verbose = TRUE)
```
